hooks.name: symea-brain-session-start
hooks.command: R="${extensionPath:-$HOME/.gemini/extensions/symea-brain}"; S="$R/hooks/symea-hook-runner.mjs"; [ -f "$S" ] || S="$HOME/.config/symea-brain/symea-hook-runner.mjs"; [ -f "$S" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; N=$(command -v node || ls /opt/homebrew/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/node 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -x "$N" ] || { [ -x "/Applications/Antigravity IDE.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron" ] && { export ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1; N="/Applications/Antigravity IDE.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron"; }; }; [ -x "$N" ] || { printf '{}\n'; exit 0; }; exec "$N" "$S" --platform gemini --event session-start
